summary: Klamath County Aermotor steel lookout, about 100 ft, built 1935-36, abandoned by the state 1974 and removed in 1991 or 1992. Sources disagree on dates and agency.

facts.design: Aermotor steel tower with a cab at the top and a 12x16 ft living cabin on the ground
facts.status_note: Removed 1991 or 1992 per the sources; a Forgotten Oregon group post says only remains are left, without describing them
facts.agency: Klamath FPA (Register); Klamath Indian Agency and Winema National Forest (Oregon Lookouts, Klamath County blog)

events.note: Register and FireLookout.com date the 100 ft steel tower to 1935; Oregon Lookouts dates the living cabin to 1935
Oregon Lookouts and the Klamath County blog date the Aermotor steel tower to 1936 (107 ft and 101 ft respectively)
Two-acre fire at the Chiloquin Lumber Company's North Marsh unit, discovered from the lookout
Under the termination act, the KFPA took over operating and maintaining the lookout
Smoke reported between Highway 97 and the railroad; a KFPA fighter found and put out a burning stump
State abandoned the lookout; at that time it was under Oregon Department of Forestry control
Klamath County blog gives removal in 1991
Register says removed in 1992; FireLookout.com says destroyed in 1992
Registered June 7, 2011; nominated by Ray Kresek

corrections.why: No source supports 4.9 m. The Register and FireLookout.com both describe a 100 ft (about 30.5 m) steel tower; Oregon Lookouts gives 107 ft and the Klamath County blog 101 ft.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register and FireLookout.com date the 100 ft tower to 1935. Oregon Lookouts dates the cabin to 1935 and the 107 ft tower to 1936; the Klamath County blog dates its 101 ft tower to 1936. The story gives 1935 for the first structure and notes the 1936 tower.
The Klamath County blog says removed 1991; the Register says removed 1992; FireLookout.com says destroyed 1992. The story gives 1992 with the blog's 1991 noted.

The Register lists the Klamath FPA as administrator. Oregon Lookouts and the Klamath County blog list the Klamath Indian Agency, Winema National Forest and Oregon Department of Forestry; Oregon Lookouts says the KFPA took over operation in 1961.
The Register and FireLookout.com say 100 ft; the Klamath County blog says 101 ft; Oregon Lookouts says 107 ft. The story uses about 100 feet.

sources.title: Forgotten Oregon group post on the Round (Jimenez) Lookout

notes_for_editor: Identity: the Oregon Lookouts page is titled 'Round Butte' (Klamath Indian Agency / Winema NF, 29S-9E-08) and the Klamath blog's 'ROUND BUTTE' entry is at Sec 8 T29S R15E; both match a 100 ft Aermotor steel tower removed in 1991 or 1992, so they are treated as this lookout. That link is inferred from location and dates, not stated by any source; the township figures differ between the two and were not resolved. Brief's height 4.9 m is unsupported and corrected to 30.5 m. The Facebook post was read only as its title line; the post's date, photo and description were not visible, so nothing beyond the caption is used. Access and visit status are not supported by any source and are left out. Event 1936 uses the Oregon Lookouts and Klamath blog dates; the Register and FireLookout.com date the tower to 1935.
